recipes.oracle_text: Bushido 1 (Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)

recipe_coverage: Reviewed bushido, flanking or exalted component: pinned Oracle casting/stats, legal complete combat declarations, both controllers, lone versus multiple attackers, multiple blockers, other attackers and sources, tapped/sick permanents, flying legality, damage/death, cleanup, stocked owned zones, and combat snapshot replay after AI backups. Flanking blockers are immune; bushido triggers once when becoming blocked; exalted counts completed declarations and stacks across sources. Separately printed activated abilities, Flash timing, trample damage allocation, multi-attack blocking, trigger counters and multiplayer remain gaps. Component coverage, not whole-card certification.
